description: This file provides utility functions for generating and working with PEP 425 compatibility tags, including platform-specific functions and tag support determination.

methods.name: str version_info_to_nodot(version_info: Tuple[int, ...])
methods.description: Converts a tuple of version numbers to a string without dots, using only the first two components.

methods.name: List[str] _mac_platforms(arch: str)
methods.description: Generates a list of Mac platform tags based on architecture string following a specific regex pattern.

methods.name: List[str] _custom_manylinux_platforms(arch: str)
methods.description: Returns platform tags for various manylinux architecture strings, considering compatibility.

methods.name: List[str] _get_custom_platforms(arch: str)
methods.description: Determines custom platform tags based on architecture string prefix, handling 'macosx' and 'manylinux' patterns.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] _expand_allowed_platforms(platforms: Optional[List[str]])
methods.description: Expands a list of platform strings into their full supported platform tags, removing duplicates.

methods.name: PythonVersion _get_python_version(version: str)
methods.description: Parses a version string into a tuple of integers representing Python version.

methods.name: str _get_custom_interpreter( implementation: Optional[str] = None, version: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Constructs a string identifying the interpreter and version.

methods.name: List[Tag] get_supported( version: Optional[str] = None, platforms: Optional[List[str]] = None, impl: Optional[str] = None, abis: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a list of supported tags given Python version, platforms, implementation, and ABIs. It combines cPython and generic tags based on input parameters.

ctags.name: _get_custom_interpreter
ctags.signature: ( implementation: Optional[str] = None, version: Optional[str] = None )

ctags.name: get_supported
ctags.signature: ( version: Optional[str] = None, platforms: Optional[List[str]] = None, impl: Optional[str] = None, abis: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
